description: A web platform for live match tracking, analytics, user authentication, and admin management.

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Allow users to register, login, and manage their accounts.

features.name: Live Match Ticker
features.description: Display live updates for ongoing matches.

features.name: Analytics Dashboard (Admin)
features.description: Admins can view analytics and user statistics.

features.name: Admin User Management
features.description: Admins can view and manage users.

features.name: Chat Widget
features.description: Users can chat during live matches.

features.name: FAQ and Contact Admin
features.description: Users can view FAQs and contact admin for support.

features.name: Pricing Page
features.description: Display pricing plans for the platform.

features.name: Testimonials and Trust Bar
features.description: Showcase user testimonials and trust signals.

features.name: PL Fixtures Integration
features.description: Integrate Premier League fixtures and kickoff times.

features.name: Admin Analytics Enhancements
features.description: Add more detailed analytics and export options for admins.

features.name: User Profile Customization
features.description: Allow users to customize their profiles (avatar, preferences).

features.name: Payment Integration
features.description: Enable users to purchase plans and handle payments.

features.name: Notification System
features.description: Send notifications to users for match updates and admin messages.

features.name: Mobile Responsiveness Improvements
features.description: Enhance mobile UI/UX for all components.

notes: The core features are implemented. The next steps are to enhance admin analytics, add user profile customization, integrate payments, implement a notification system, and improve mobile responsiveness.
